endonym.gloss: a gloss of a drummed sign rather than a spoken name; the local rendering is a rhythm

description.value: A carbon world with a graphite crust, tar plains and a lowland basin two thousand kilometres across in which the haze pools and never entirely clears. The inhabited ground is the rim of that basin, where the air thins enough to work in and the rock stays warm from below. Signals here travel through the ground rather than the air, including, so far as anyone can tell, all of the conversation. Four descents in forty-seven years, and no visit has yet seen more than a dozen individuals at once.
Ogljikov svet z grafitno skorjo in kotlino, polno megle; naseljen je le njen rob.

Um mundo de carbono com crosta de grafite, planícies de alcatrão e uma bacia deprimida com dois mil quilómetros de diâmetro onde a bruma se acumula e nunca desanuvia por completo. O terreno habitado é o bordo dessa bacia, onde o ar rareia o suficiente para se poder trabalhar e a rocha se mantém quente por baixo. Aqui os sinais viajam pelo solo e não pelo ar, incluindo, tanto quanto se percebe, a totalidade da conversa. Quatro descidas em quarenta e sete anos, e nenhuma visita viu ainda mais de uma dúzia de indivíduos ao mesmo tempo.

atmosphere.value: Nitrogen, carbon monoxide and a persistent organic haze at 1.6 bar. Not breathable, and the haze lays a fine black film over everything within the hour, including the inside of a mask that has been opened once.

biosphere.value: Life is present: 1 catalogued species (Basin Rim Drummers) and 1 recorded non-sapient organism. The survey is not claimed to be complete.

notes.value: The first survey spent eleven days recording the air for a language before somebody thought to put a geophone on the ground.
